section.title: Frequently Asked Questions — Education Mailing Services
section.description: Answers on proof, verification, pricing, and processing for schools and universities.

faqs.q: Is proof of mailing included with every letter?
faqs.a: Yes — digital proof is provided for each letter processed. A certified mail upgrade is available for real-time USPS tracking on priority items.
Real-time verification is built-in and flags potential issues before printing, helping reduce returned mail and administrative rework.

faqs.q: What is the starting price per letter?
faqs.a: $1.31 per letter for qualifying specifications (1-page, single-sided black & white, including envelope and postage).

faqs.q: What is the typical processing timeframe?
faqs.a: Same-day processing applies when files are approved by noon CT, followed by prompt submission to USPS.
